ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 1:12, primarily localized to scar clusters and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across 90% of the fluke. Discrete high-intensity circular blobs are mapped in the central and lower-right regions of the right lobe. Diffuse mid-intensity grey mottling is detected in the upper-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box recession.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular negative-y deviations (deep notches). Right lobe trailing edge displays a more continuous boundary with higher-frequency, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall upward convex curve from the central notch, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12 circular high-contrast pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) forming a loose spatial constellation on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear disruptions are visible in the upper-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep, irregular traumatic indentations (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Dense, high-relief calcified clusters (barnacle colonies) are present on both the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the extreme lateral tips creates a high-contrast textured profile distinct from the smoother trailing edge boundary.
